notes.title: New Game Update!
notes.content:
Hello fellow summoners!

Another update for Rogue Summoner is live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/f7eba3485d0458c15f44d57549d7e15ac8fa41e5.gif

Here is a list of the main fixes:

 Fixed bug of the frozen effect of a crystal disappearing when doing the turn prediction
 Fixed bug of monster rotation not resetting in the beginning of the turn.
 Fixed bug where heal attacks were being affected by Taunts.
 Smaller Fixes and Quality of Life improvements.



We are having a blast reading your reviews and comments on Rogue Summoner!
Seeing you enjoy the game is what motivates us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/b3af2338b824bf165e8cb656e890769d5b06ddac.png

Cheers!

notes.title: Rogue Summoner - First Post-Launch Update!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

My brother and I hope you are having a blast with Rogue Summoner!
We have tons of awesome updates coming for you down the line, so make sure to follow us to be notified about them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/93bfc59a40e581690e9f24d0e2a571f2b2157a18.gif

For now, we have updated the game to version 1.1.16, with improvements to fix the problems you have been having with the game.

Here is a list of the main fixes:

 Fixed crash caused by loading monsters that would be in the way of a Power Rock.
 Fixed Ancient Destruction Bestiary description.
 Fixed Energy Immunity text on Arrow Head Monster Info entry.
 Fixed bug where a Monster Essence would stay in play when it's supposed to be destroyed.
 Fixed typo on book "The Height of a Rogue Summoner - Volume II".


It would be really awesome if you could leave a review for Rogue Summoner after playing it!
It will help people make an informed decision about the game as well as help us know how we can improve the game in future updates! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/b3af2338b824bf165e8cb656e890769d5b06ddac.png

Cheers!

notes.title: Rogue Summoner Release
notes.content:
Rogue Summoner has been released into the world! Go get it while it's hot. :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/

[previewyoutube=-OJ-4xKp8HE;full][/previewyoutube]


All about Rogue Summoner

Rogue Summoner is a roguelike about summoning creatures to fight for you.
It's a unique blend between turn-based tactics, roguelikes, strategy, auto battlers and even chess!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/9984c3fc5dd6886397e7d8f4709d0495d0bdc4a1.gif

After you create your strategy, the enemies will do their move, then, your creatures, each according to their behavior.
To become a Rogue Summoner you must master each monster's behavior and use them creatively in combat.

Check out this developer commentary video:

[previewyoutube=y-6dhXdG98s;full][/previewyoutube]


Enjoy!

Dan and Tiago Zaidan
 - Gamecraft Studios

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/

notes.title: Bestiary, Minimap and Library
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Today we have a very special update for you, because we have included some features that have been requested by some players!


Minimap
No more needless wondering! You can now see where are you in the current level (as well as which level you are).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/ef1347af284a27f3ab91b06c4407b96ca9cb0152.png


Bestiary
Learn all about the creatures you will fight against (and with) in your adventures! When you kill a creature 10 times it will show up in your bestiary, so you can reference its behavior whenever you need.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/bef5412e7a09d3585c5976f7249903e038de2892.png


Library
After you collect a book, it will show up in your library. Now can read about Aktis Head-Head, Licos the Double-And-A-Half-Turn, Jairus Out-Of-The-Blue and all the other Rogue Summoners in one go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/86994213175f30985c037b858deb566a1cd7802c.png



What feature would you like to see in Rogue Summoner?

We are working very hard to improve the game and we would love to hear what you think about it! :)

Download the Demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/

Thanks

notes.title: Destructible Crystals and New Magic Rings
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

I bring you another BIG update for Rogue Summoner (and its Demo).
Here are some highlights of what you will find now in your adventures:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/28dcecda505ee49e53168eb494d945d4219307b1.png


Destructible Crystals

You will come across rare crystals in your runs - both ally and enemy.
An enemy crystal must be destroyed, while an ally crystal must be protected.
If you succeed, you can expect handsome rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/e6034d07868901b6d434563a96594bc7313babfa.png



New Magic Rings

There are 5 new magic rings in the game - and you can also stack them up!
Here is how they look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/761d201cdcee58f07859ebf71c10d57354065f24.png

Luckily, the summoner is far enough from the camera that we don't have to make him wear 20+ rings... :P


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/9b73c632b35e51960b8635a3ebf1b04b927f80a2.png

Constant Improvements

There were other fixes and rebalances throughout all dungeons.
Thanks to everyone who has been playing and giving their feedback. As you can see, we really appreciate it and are using it to make the game better!

You can expect more awesome updates in the following weeks!

Download the Demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/

Thanks!

notes.title: New Game Mechanics: Magic Rings, Power Rock
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We continue to work very hard on Rogue Summoner to improve it continually!

We heard great things about the Prediction System we added in an update a few days ago, and today we added two new major game systems!


Magic Rings
Some of you mentioned that the game could use more kinds of items so we added Magic Rings!

They will give you an edge in combat (but are not so easy to get!). :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/4f06b18e8fae36064a0534920f577d8f78f6b641.png


Power Rocks
Scattered throughout the randomly generated dungeons, you may now come across a Power Rock (not to be confused with Power Metal).

They will change the dynamic of combat on a certain place in the board: like buffing the monsters, making it more expensive to summon them or nullify the mana gain from the enemies.

You will find 16 kinds of Power Rocks on your adventures and each one will make you adapt your strategy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/a93a761b71b3ca7e973f0c35626bce104083bdeb.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/d92920e60a9b1cef53360d6b88a600191b612caf.png


Thank you to everyone who gave ideas for Rogue Summoner! We think these were great additions to the game and we'd love to hear what you think about it!

Any feedback is welcome because we are trying to make Rogue Summoner the best game it can be!

Download the Free Demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/


Cheers!

notes.title: Major Demo Improvements! Prediction System, Story and Fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/4427ae80e0f3caea085fca93161d020a37fad359.png

Major Update on the Demo!!


Hello fellow summoners!

There has been a major update on Rogue Summoner's free Demo! 

A lot of players said that the game was too difficult and that it wasn't clear how the enemies would react to your strategy. Because of that, we have implemented the prediction system: a system that helps you make your strategy by showing in real-time how the enemies will react to your summons. Check it out!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/56d2ac422c98ecb9854ff80c1828e73e8d8863d2.gif


Another great addition to the game was its story! It's something that we wanted to do from the very beginning and we're are very happy to have finished it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/fa69929bd9bd15aeeb1e93e75dcc44b654867bbd.gif

"The first Rogue Summoner was, of course, Aktis Half-Head. The story of how he got that nickname is paramount to understanding what it means to become Rogue."


And lastly, there has been several bug fixes  and small improvements. One that I'm very happy with is the ability to use the scroll wheel to rotate your monsters. With this implemented, the entire game can be played exclusively with the mouse, making it more accessible!


Download the Free Demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355510/Rogue_Summoner/


We hope you enjoy it!

We would love to hear what you think about these improvements (and the game in general!) as we work towards making it the best we can.

Cheers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38208119/ffbb7cafc13e4bafb908ee762e6c76c162704cb2.png
